collections.name: blog
collections.label: Blog
collections.description: Each post is one file in src/lib/content/blog. The file name becomes the address: /blog/the-file-name.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.hint: The address of the post comes from the title the first time it is saved. Changing the title later does not change the address.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: Shown on the blog page and in search results. Keep it under about 155 characters.

fields.name: coverAlt
fields.label: Cover image description
fields.hint: Describe the image for screen readers. Leave empty if it is decorative.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: Draft
fields.hint: Drafts are hidden from the site.
